rules.name: Statement of Identity on PDP
rules.description: Product identity (e.g. 'Granola') must appear on Principal Display Panel bold and parallel to base.

rules.name: Net Quantity Dual Unit Declaration
rules.description: Net weight must declare both US Customary ounces and metric grams in bottom 30% of PDP.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Serving Size Math
rules.description: Total package servings multiplied by declared serving size must equal declared net weight.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Calorie Atwater Math
rules.description: Declared calories must align with macronutrient Atwater calculation (Fat*9 + Carb*4 + Protein*4).

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Total Fat % Daily Value
rules.description: % Daily Value for Total Fat must be calculated based on 78g reference Daily Value.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Saturated Fat % Daily Value
rules.description: % Daily Value for Saturated Fat must be calculated based on 20g reference Daily Value.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Trans Fat Declaration
rules.description: Trans Fat content must be explicitly declared in grams.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Cholesterol % Daily Value
rules.description: % Daily Value for Cholesterol must be calculated based on 300mg reference Daily Value.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Sodium % Daily Value
rules.description: % Daily Value for Sodium must be calculated based on 2,300mg reference Daily Value.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Total Carbohydrate % Daily Value
rules.description: % Daily Value for Total Carbohydrate must be calculated based on 275g reference Daily Value.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Dietary Fiber % Daily Value
rules.description: % Daily Value for Dietary Fiber must be calculated based on 28g reference Daily Value.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Added Sugars Declaration
rules.description: Added sugars must be stated as 'Includes Xg Added Sugars' with % Daily Value (based on 50g DV).

rules.name: Nutrition Facts Mandatory Micronutrients
rules.description: Vitamin D (20mcg DV), Calcium (1300mg DV), Iron (18mg DV), and Potassium (4700mg DV) must be declared.

rules.name: Nutrition Facts 2,000 Calorie Footnote
rules.description: Mandatory footnote: 'The % Daily Value tells you how much a nutrient in a serving of food contributes to a daily diet. 2,000 calories a day is used for general nutrition advice.'

rules.name: Ingredient List Descending Predominance
rules.description: Ingredients must be listed by common or usual name in descending order of predominance by weight.

rules.name: FALCPA Major Allergen Disclosure
rules.description: Major allergens present as intentional ingredients must be explicitly declared and cannot be listed only in 'May Contain'.

rules.name: Tree Nut Specific Species Declaration
rules.description: Tree nuts must be declared by specific botanical/common species name (e.g. Almonds, Pecans, Walnuts).

rules.name: No Added Sugar Claim Substantiation
rules.description: 'No Added Sugar' claims are invalid if product contains added sugars/honey or if added sugars are declared > 0g.

rules.name: Responsible Party Address
rules.description: Label must state name and complete address including city, state, and zip code of manufacturer, packer, or distributor.

rules.name: Barcode Check Digit Verification
rules.description: UPC-A / GTIN-12 barcode must have a mathematically valid modulo 10 check digit.
